events.title: Zoolights
events.blurb: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium's holiday light display opens its 2026 season Friday and runs nightly through January 3, 2027. Online timed tickets are required.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo de luces navideñas de Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium abre su temporada 2026 el viernes y sigue todas las noches hasta el 3 de enero de 2027. Se requieren boletos en línea con horario.

events.title: 81st Annual Tacoma Tree Lighting
events.blurb: Tacoma City Theaters and the City of Tacoma kick off the holiday season with the city's 81st annual tree lighting at the Pantages Theater. Check the event page for the start time.
events.blurbEs: Tacoma City Theaters y la Ciudad de Tacoma inauguran la temporada navideña con el 81.º encendido anual del árbol de la ciudad en el Pantages Theater. Consulta la hora de inicio en la página del evento.
events.getThere: Arrive early for parking, or park downtown and ride the Link light rail.

events.title: Tacoma Concert Band: Sounds of the Season
events.blurb: The Tacoma Concert Band's holiday concert in the historic Pantages Theater. Tickets are free for youth 18 and under when picked up in person at the Pantages box office.
events.blurbEs: El concierto navideño de la Tacoma Concert Band en el histórico Pantages Theater. Los boletos son gratis para jóvenes de 18 años o menos si se recogen en persona en la taquilla del Pantages.
events.getThere: Arrive early for parking, or park downtown and ride the Link light rail.

events.title: Gabriel Rutledge
events.blurb: Stand-up from Gabriel Rutledge at the club's downtown room, with five shows over three nights.
events.blurbEs: Comedia en vivo de Gabriel Rutledge en la sala del centro del club, con cinco funciones en tres noches.

events.title: Tacoma Cabaret: Tales from the Crypt
events.blurb: A campy horror-themed cabaret in the Spanish Ballroom, with burlesque, aerial and pole acts, live vocals, comedy and dance. Two shows; doors open an hour before each.
events.blurbEs: Un cabaret de terror con humor en el Spanish Ballroom, con burlesque, acrobacias aéreas y en barra, canto en vivo, comedia y baile. Dos funciones; las puertas abren una hora antes de cada una.

events.title: Chihuly Bridge of Glass
events.blurb: A pedestrian bridge lined with Dale Chihuly glass, by the Museum of Glass.
events.blurbEs: Un puente peatonal con obras de vidrio de Dale Chihuly, junto al Museum of Glass.
